1.consolidated_definition: Experimentado, competente. Se dice del político o profesional de mucha experiencia y con buenas cualidades. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Durante el evento de fin de semana que estuvo marcado por una pobre particpación, Cifuentes se desenvolvió con la soltura y el carisma de un político sazonado
1.en_consolidated_definition: Experienced, competent. Said of a politician or professional with much experience and good qualities. Adapted Anglicism, infrequently used. During the weekend event marked by poor participation, Cifuentes performed with the ease and charisma of a seasoned politician.
